pr_title: Don't yeet focus to the control when the tab renamer is opened
pr_body:
This is a hotfix to #10048. When the tab renamer is opened, we need to make sure to not immediately steal focus from it.

* [x] closes #10112
* [x] I work here
* [x] tested manually

issue_context.title: Right-click on a tab... "Rename Tab" broken after #10048
issue_context.body:
I did something wrong in #10048 and now when we close the context menu, we immediately toss focus into the control, which means that the renamer immediately loses focus and dismisses itself. Oops.

See also #6680
